Accepts input/output costs specified either as token counts or as text (auto-tokenized using o200k encoding with ~7.6% margin of error). Token counts take precedence if both are provided. Returns cost breakdown per model with 'costSplit' indicating input vs. output cost distribution. Note: Does not account for caching, batch discounts, or tiered pricing. Output token estimates are inherently uncertain since final output length is unknown.
